● LIVE

The Qur'an, drawn live 🕌

The real clock drives everything. Each hour of the day belongs to 9 surahs. A glowing point walks the 14×14 letter-grid over a real antique map of Arabia — moon letters choose the column, sun letters the row.

🟢 Spotters: type any word (left rail) and a pointer tracks its letters on the map. Click anywhere on the map to plant a green holder on a square.

🌸 Squares bloom flowers at 100 / 200 / 300 lifetime visits. When al-Haram, an-Nabawi or al-Aqsa are mentioned, their real photo rises over the map.

⚔ Action bar (keys 1–7): cast Quranic abilities — Fātiḥah, Āyat al-Kursī, Tadabbur, Nūr Surge, Sajdah, Duʿāʾ, Takbīr — powered by نور you earn from every letter, marker and maze win.
